# CognitiveFeedbackLoop

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism where the output of a cognitive process is fed back as input to the same process, enabling iterative self-correction and learning. Enables neuromorphic hardware to implement adaptive, self-improving behaviors without external supervision, key for in-network intelligence.
